market.historical_execution_proxy: 00:15 UTC bar open plus adverse friction
market.fx_policy: Use timestamped executable CLP/USD conversion for realized CLP results; constant FX is a labeled sensitivity only
market.candidate_gate: Verify source, historical coverage, trading calendar, executable FX and all-in costs before inclusion

portfolio.missing_execution_quote: Do not fill; defer to first valid quote without changing cost or stopping rules

reversal.entry_rule: most recent daily log return <= negative two times the standard deviation of the prior 21 daily returns

ridge.role: Filter entries from each simple rule
ridge.target: log return from executable entry proxy to executable exit proxy
ridge.entry_rule: Predicted log return exceeds round-trip trading cost in log-return units
ridge.exit_rule: Exit at holding horizon or portfolio barrier, whichever triggers first

validation.final_holdout_access: Only after one strategy and its parameters are frozen
validation.parameter_selection: inner chronological folds; compare net performance against same-horizon simple parents
validation.purge_rule: Exclude labels whose executable exit meets or crosses validation or test start
validation.primary_window_origin: First eligible day of evaluation period
validation.incomplete_window_policy: Exclude incomplete windows; report coverage and count
validation.eligibility_note: Exploratory minimums; confidence intervals and effective sample size still govern interpretation
sensitivity: alternate 60-day window origins as secondary analysis

monte_carlo.method: paired stationary bootstrap within contiguous out-of-sample spans
monte_carlo.input: daily net portfolio returns including cash days, after simulated costs
monte_carlo.limitation: Daily-return resampling estimates a model-conditional first-passage proxy; obey an explicit daily observation rule, and use event replay for next-fill slippage and gaps.
